title: The Complete Guide to JDL Football in NSW
subtitle: Everything a new player needs to know: the league, the rules, the clubs and the skills
version_note: Rules, dates and club details as published by Football NSW for the 2026 season, checked on 13 October 2026.
description: An independent, inspiring guide for new players in Football NSW's Junior Development League (JDL): the history, the Under 10 rules, 19 clubs ranked and profiled, and how to build the skills the JDL asks for: ball mastery, football brain, fitness, fuel, mindset and teamwork.
creator: JDL Guide
rights: Independent guide. Not made, approved or endorsed by Football NSW, Football Australia or any club. Photos are credited in the book under their own licences.
title_notes: An independent guide. Not made, approved or endorsed by Football NSW, Football Australia or any club named in it.
accessibility_summary: Reflowable text with a contents list and headings. Every diagram and photo has a text description, and the rules and rankings in the diagrams are also written out in the text.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Pick three and use them at training this week.
